_comment: Manually-injected actors and edges that don't come from any source document. Used for entries like IDP supervisors, co-authors, or other credits that should appear in the graph but weren't extracted from the ecosystem data. Injected by merge_all.py AFTER normal cross-document merging, so these entries bypass merge_rewrites.json (they're already in their final form). Their functional_space, helix_pair, canonical_actor_key, and layout coordinates are computed automatically by merge_all.py -- you don't specify them here.

_schema.nodes: List of actor records. Required: entity. Recommended: category, helix, sphere, r_and_d, role_in_text. helix is used to compute edge functional_space, so set it correctly. If an actor with the same canonical_key already exists (from real source data), the fixture is skipped with a warning -- fixtures are for actors NOT in the extracted data.
_schema.edges: List of edge records. Required: source_actor, target_actor, relation_label. If either endpoint's canonical_key resolves to no node (fixture or otherwise), the edge is skipped with a warning. source_helix/target_helix/functional_space/helix_pair are auto-computed from the resolved endpoint nodes -- do NOT set them here.

nodes.role_in_text: IDP supervisor at TUM Chair for Strategy and Organization
